name: Solfeggio 174 Hz - Foundation & Pain Relief
description: The lowest of the Solfeggio frequencies. Associated with pain reduction, a sense of security and safety, and grounding. Said to give organs a sense of security and encourage them to heal.

name: Solfeggio 285 Hz - Tissue Regeneration
description: Associated with healing and regenerating tissues and organs. Said to influence energy fields and help restructure damaged tissue.

name: Solfeggio 396 Hz - Liberation from Fear & Guilt
description: Associated with liberating guilt and fear, and turning grief into joy. Often used for grounding and removing negative blocks.

name: Solfeggio 417 Hz - Facilitating Change
description: Associated with undoing negative situations, facilitating change, and clearing traumatic experiences. Said to re-connect with a pure and stable life force.

name: Solfeggio 528 Hz - DNA Repair & Miracles
description: Perhaps the most well-known Solfeggio frequency. Called the "Love frequency" or "Miracle tone". Associated with transformation, DNA repair, and increased life energy.

name: Solfeggio 639 Hz - Relationships & Harmony
description: Associated with connecting and balancing relationships, enhancing communication, understanding, and tolerance. Said to promote harmony in relationships.

name: Solfeggio 741 Hz - Awakening Intuition
description: Associated with solving problems, awakening intuition, and cleansing toxins and electromagnetic radiation. Said to clean cells and promote a healthier lifestyle.

name: Solfeggio 852 Hz - Spiritual Order & Clarity
description: Associated with returning to spiritual order, awakening inner strength, and raising awareness. Said to help replace negative thoughts with positive ones.

name: Solfeggio 963 Hz - Divine Consciousness
description: The highest Solfeggio frequency. Associated with divine consciousness, enlightenment, and reconnecting with the higher self and spiritual realm. Said to activate the pineal gland.
